thread:
Nora (AE): Heads up - HealthFlow POC pinned `redwood-lex-3` in ca-west and getting `deprecation_notice` when calling. They want to know if the deprecated variant is safe for short-term use and what the migration path looks like. Also asking for Dedicated in-region pricing with HSM.
Eli (SRE): paste payload? Hosted or Dedicated?
Nora (AE): Hosted. payload:

```
HTTP 410
{"error":"model_deprecated", "message":"redwood-lex-3 (ca-west) deprecated; alternative: redwood-lex-3-quant or redwood-lex-4 in us-west"}
```

Nora (AE): customer tied to `lex-3` version for their prompt tuning.
Carlos (Sales Eng): deprecation in ca-west was part of pruning old quant builds. short-term safe if they accept potential output variance. we can offer cross-region fallback to lex-4 (different base weights) but that changes outputs.
compliance-bot: deprecation-notice logged (id: dcn-4421).
Eli (SRE): options: 1) replicate legacy lex-3 artifact to ca-west (48-72h + infra signoff) 2) allow cross-region fallback to us-west with audit logs 3) recommended upgrade to lex-4 with migration guide.
Nora (AE): customer needs timeline and Dedicated price estimate for 2k reqs/min. also HSM.
Carlos (Sales Eng): estimate for Dedicated + HSM: rough $MMk/month (placeholder) - will refine. if they need deterministic outputs, recommend replication + keep version pinned while we build regen tests.
Eli (SRE): I'll queue replication and tag as P1 for POC. note: replication doesn't restore deprecated support forever - it's a temporary hold.
Nora (AE): compliance concerns: customer says PHI cannot leave CA. can we do Dedicated in-region with HSM faster?
Eli (SRE): Dedicated private nodes in ca-west are possible but provisioning + HSM setup is 3-7 business days. For PoC we can provision a temporary dedicated slice if capacity available; need sales approval.
compliance-bot: HSM onboarding checklist initiated (req-1229).
Carlos (Sales Eng): propose two routes for Nora to present: A) Temporary cross-region fallback with signed consent + detailed audit logs, B) Fast-track Dedicated in-region with HSM (3-7 days). Include a note about output drift and recommend eval harness.
Nora (AE): thank you. action items: Eli start replication request, Carlos prepare Dedicated estimate + migration notes, I'll send customer both options and ask for legal contact for consent.
Carlos (Sales Eng): quick note - quant variants can change tokenization; recommend customers run their fine-tuned prompts through both models. I can run a quick A/B and post diffs.
Eli (SRE): replication job created id 10011. ETA 48h.
Nora (AE): looping in customer legal now. will update when they reply.
Carlos (Sales Eng): A/B quick: lex-3 vs lex-4 shows similar intent detection but different phrasing on longer outputs; will attach summary.
